notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Will, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 3.
